_comment: Plate map layout corpus (BIZ-405). Shared by frontend/src/components/plateMap/*.test.ts(x) and backend/tests/services/test_plate_map.py: both implementations must reproduce every expectation. Expected values are hand-computed from the layout spec in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-26-biz-405-plate-map.md; `expect` is partial (only the keys present are checked); `hits` are bed-mm click points and the label a click reports.

cases.name: square-front-left
cases.covers: axis direction: bed front (small Y) at the bottom; X not mirrored

cases.name: centre-origin
cases.covers: origin at the bed centre, negative coordinates

cases.name: back-right-origin
cases.covers: origin at the back-right corner: every coordinate negative

cases.name: scale-wide-large
cases.covers: very large, non-square bed keeps its aspect ratio; the min hit area scales from the larger side

cases.name: scale-small-portrait
cases.covers: very small, portrait bed keeps its aspect ratio

cases.name: tiny-object
cases.covers: a 2 mm object gets a minimum hit area

cases.name: overlap
cases.covers: overlapping footprints: smaller on top, ties by input order (later on top)

cases.name: concave-l
cases.covers: concave polygon: hit-test and marker follow the real shape, not the bbox

cases.name: rotated-rect
cases.covers: rotated rectangle: bbox corners are not the object

cases.name: off-bed
cases.covers: objects partly or wholly off the bed (sideways and behind) are drawn and flagged

cases.name: labels
cases.covers: long and hostile labels are text, never markup; truncation counts code points

objects.label: Left bracket, mirrored, 0.2 mm layer, 15% gyroid infill, PETG, for the rear cable tray assembly revision C - reprint of the failed copy from the morning batch, keep separate from the main order bin pl

cases.name: six-states
cases.covers: states differ by pattern as well as colour; a non-hex colour renders neutral

cases.name: mixed-selectable
cases.covers: non-selectable objects ignore clicks and do not pass them through

cases.name: missing-footprint
cases.covers: an object without a footprint is listed, not drawn

cases.name: hostile-states
cases.covers: state names are text; a colour must be exactly #rgb/#rrggbb (no prefix match)

invalid.name: zero width bed
invalid.message: bed: width and depth must be positive numbers

invalid.name: boolean depth
invalid.message: bed: width and depth must be positive numbers

invalid.name: string origin
invalid.message: bed: origin must be finite numbers

invalid.name: bed not an object
invalid.message: bed: width and depth must be positive numbers

invalid.name: numeric colour
invalid.message: states: id, name and color must be strings

invalid.name: empty label
invalid.message: objects: label must be a non-empty string

invalid.name: numeric label
invalid.message: objects: label must be a non-empty string

invalid.name: string selectable
invalid.message: objects: selectable must be a boolean

invalid.name: two-point polygon
invalid.message: footprint: polygon needs at least 3 points

invalid.name: string coordinate
invalid.message: footprint: coordinates must be finite numbers

invalid.name: boolean coordinate
invalid.message: footprint: coordinates must be finite numbers

invalid.name: inverted box
invalid.message: footprint: box must be [x0, y0, x1, y1] with x0 < x1 and y0 < y1

invalid.name: short box
invalid.message: footprint: box must be [x0, y0, x1, y1] with x0 < x1 and y0 < y1

invalid.name: origin not an object
invalid.message: bed: origin must be finite numbers

invalid.name: state not an object
invalid.message: states: id, name and color must be strings

invalid.name: huge bed
invalid.message: bed: width and depth must be positive numbers

invalid.message: footprint: coordinates must be finite numbers
